title: Localized Curvature Domination and Rigidity of Harmonic Maps
summary: We establish a localized Bochner-type rigidity theorem for harmonic maps between Riemannian manifolds. Let $f : (M,g) \to (\overline{M},\overline{g})$ be a harmonic map from a compact manifold. Instead of assuming a global nonpositivity condition on the sectional curvature of the target, we impose a curvature bound localized to the image $f(M)$, expressed via the maximal sectional curvature encountered along the image.
